about.title: About Me
about.text:
Hi, I'm Ossgo — a full-stack engineer with over 15 years of experience. Starting with iOS development in 2009, I've built up diverse technical experience across Objective-C, Swift, Flutter, React Native, and Next.js, along with backend API development.

I've worked on a wide range of projects — from Bluetooth fitness hardware, AI-powered nursing systems, to inventory management and POS systems. spanning a wide range of industries and use cases. Recently, I've integrated AI tools like Claude Code into my workflow to boost development efficiency and code quality. I've been working fully remote since 2019, collaborating with multiple companies and teams. I'm well-versed in Scrum and agile workflows, with strong async communication and self-management skills. Currently open to freelance and remote full-time opportunities — feel free to reach out!

contact.title: Contact
contact.cta: Have a project in mind? Let's work together.

duo-caption.name: DuoCaption — Netflix Bilingual Subtitles
duo-caption.short: A Chrome extension for bilingual Netflix subtitles — hover to translate, save sentences, and learn with spaced repetition.
duo-caption.description: DuoCaption is a Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that displays bilingual subtitles on Netflix. It intercepts Netflix subtitle tracks to show two languages side by side; hovering a word pauses the video and reveals its translation and pronunciation. Users can save words and sentences, loop-replay a single line, and reinforce memory through a dedicated review page powered by spaced repetition (SRS). The interface supports 8 languages.
features: Side-by-side bilingual subtitles (intercepts Netflix TTML tracks)
Hover a word to pause the video and see instant translation & pronunciation
Save words/sentences and loop-replay any single line
Spaced-repetition (SRS) review page with learning stats
Draggable toolbar and WYSIWYG settings panel

danei-master.name: DaNei Master - Lock Expert
danei-master.short: Dispatch management app for locksmiths — one-tap order acceptance, scheduling, and progress tracking.
danei-master.description: A dispatch management app designed for locksmiths. Through LINE login, locksmiths receive real-time work order notifications, can arrange scheduling, review work content and history. After completion, customers can confirm acceptance directly in the app.

beverage-pos.name: Beverage Shop POS
beverage-pos.short: POS system for drink shops with credit card, Line Pay, and dual-screen support.
beverage-pos.description: A Flutter-based POS system for beverage shops. Supports credit card (Stripe), Google Pay, Apple Pay, and Line Pay payments, idle carousel advertisements, dual-screen display (merchant inputs amount, customer screen shows QR code), and multi-language support.

laundry-app.name: Laundry App
laundry-app.short: Map-based laundry shop finder with machine status, online tickets, and QR activation.
laundry-app.description: Laundry shop app with map-based search, real-time washer/dryer status display, completion notifications, online ticket purchases, and QR code device activation.

postcard-app.name: Postcard App
postcard-app.short: Location-based postcard app — buy designer postcards, unlock spots, and send physical postcards.
postcard-app.description: Developed 2022-2023 as part of a startup team. Users can browse and purchase designer postcards in the marketplace, unlock location-specific postcards by visiting places or scanning QR codes, customize postcards, and have them physically printed and mailed.

voucher-app.name: Voucher App
voucher-app.short: Event ticket booking and management app with QR code verification.
voucher-app.description: Ticket management app. Full flow: event browsing, ticket purchase & checkout, QR code ticket usage, staff verification scanning, and scan history query.

cloud-nursing.name: Cloud Nursing Station
cloud-nursing.short: AI-powered cloud nursing station — real-time patient vital sign monitoring and safety alerts.
cloud-nursing.description: AI cloud nursing station app developed in 2022. Monitors patients via thermal imaging with real-time alerts for falls, bed exits, and vital sign anomalies. Features zone monitoring, history queries, daily routine analysis, and per-bed notification settings.
features: Real-time patient status with thermal imaging

card-editor.name: Flashcard Editor App
card-editor.short: Preschool flashcard DIY editor integrated into the joyphoto printing app.
card-editor.description: Flashcard editing tool based on Montessori three-stage learning. Supports text, images, stickers, shapes with advanced features like synchronized multi-card editing, copy/paste, and alignment guides.

order-system.name: Order System: Merchant App
order-system.short: Takeout order management with Bluetooth receipt printing and order status tracking.
order-system.description: Merchant takeout order management app launched early 2021, running on Lenovo tablet. Full order lifecycle: receive, prepare, ready, picked up, cancelled. With sound notifications, Bluetooth receipt printing, and business hours management.

merchant-backend.name: Merchant Order Dashboard
merchant-backend.short: Merchant backend with analytics, menu editing, and revenue withdrawal.
merchant-backend.description: Merchant order management dashboard developed 2019-2020, responsive for mobile and tablet. Features order management, analytics dashboard, menu editing, ad carousel management, member records, credit card binding, and revenue withdrawal.

turnip-farmers.name: Turnip Farmers Club
turnip-farmers.short: Animal Crossing turnip trading community with queue system and real-time chat.
turnip-farmers.description: Community app for Animal Crossing players, built in early 2020. Helps players find high turnip prices with island management, visitor search, queue system with password notifications, real-time chat, friend following, and push notifications.

cycleboxer.name: CycleBoxer
cycleboxer.short: Boxing + cycling fitness app with Bluetooth hardware integration.
cycleboxer.description: Fitness app developed in 2018 for a startup sports equipment company. Combines boxing punch machine and stationary bike via Bluetooth, tracking punch accuracy, progress, and heart rate in real-time. Includes workout history, social sharing, and OTA firmware updates.

chat-app.name: Chat App
chat-app.short: iOS native chat app with stickers, group chat, and photo markup.
chat-app.description: Developed in 2015 using native iOS Objective-C. Features include sticker sending, group chat, and photo drawing/markup.

bluetooth-watch.name: Bluetooth Smartwatch
bluetooth-watch.short: UI development for Bluetooth smartwatch companion app.
bluetooth-watch.description: Contributed to UI development for a Bluetooth smartwatch companion app using Swift.

camera-surveillance.name: Camera Surveillance App
camera-surveillance.short: Multi-camera connection, control, and recording surveillance app.
camera-surveillance.description: iOS surveillance app developed in 2014 using Objective-C. Supports multiple camera connections, real-time monitoring, and recording controls.

sports-brand-web.name: Sports Brand Website
sports-brand-web.short: Fitness class booking and venue rental website with ECPay logistics integration.
sports-brand-web.description: Sports brand website with fitness class booking, venue rental, and ECPay logistics integration features.

crypto-signal.name: CryptoSignal
crypto-signal.short: Real-time crypto trading signal app with multi-strategy buy/sell recommendations.
crypto-signal.description: A real-time cryptocurrency trading signal app built with Next.js + TypeScript. Monitors BTC and ETH price movements and automatically generates buy/sell recommendations through multiple strategies.
features: K-line charts with signal markers and indicator details
Real-time push notifications with per-strategy Web Push subscription
Signal history with win rate statistics

note-ai.name: Note AI
note-ai.short: Paste a link, get structured notes — supports YouTube videos and web articles.
note-ai.description: A 'link-to-notes' system. Users submit a YouTube video or web URL, and the system automatically extracts content, analyzes it via local LLM, and produces structured notes with auto-generated tags, cover images, full-text search, and tag filtering.
features: Async task queue with progress tracking and auto-retry
AI auto-detects content type (recipe vs. article)

kings-worrying.name: Number Hero
kings-worrying.short: Cocos2D number-matching game — eliminate to power up and defeat monsters.
kings-worrying.description: A Cocos2D game developed in 2013. Click numbers to increase them; match 3 identical numbers to eliminate them and increase the hero's power. Defeat the monster to win.
